comments: Loupe is an evaluation tool only. It does not modify or remediate page content, and it is not an overlay. All analysis runs locally in the user's browser; no page content or URL is transmitted to any server.
features: Loupe runs an instant WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 audit on any page using the axe-core engine, highlighting each failing element in context with a plain-English explanation and the fix. Scanning is free and runs entirely in the browser, so nothing is uploaded. Pro adds multi-page crawls and white-label PDF reports for clients.
title: Loupe
